title: Accuracy-Cost Trade-offs for Reference VQE Calculations of H$_2$ on IBM Quantum Hardware
summary: We present a hardware-validated reference dataset for variational ground-state energy calculations of the hydrogen molecule H\(_2\) on several IBM Quantum processors available in 2026. Using a standardized workflow, we benchmark the impact of shot count, backend choice, optimization strategy, and runtime variability on the achievable energy accuracy relative to exact diagonalization.
